title: Mobile Banking Application
description: A secure and user-friendly mobile banking application with biometric authentication, real-time transactions, and comprehensive financial management tools. Designed with accessibility and security as top priorities.

images.description: Login screen with biometric authentication options, featuring clean design and multiple security layers for user protection
Dashboard overview displaying account balances, recent transactions, and quick action buttons with intuitive iconography
Transaction history with advanced filtering, search capabilities, and detailed transaction information in an easy-to-scan format
Money transfer interface with contact selection, amount input, and confirmation screens designed for error prevention
